verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI is Google's official, open-source terminal AI agent with extensive first-party documentation (repo, docs.google.com pages) covering installation, scripting, MCP integration, and agentic workflows, and is corroborated by independent Cloud Shell/product docs and hands-on community use. Missing for 10: some hands-on reports describe reliability/quality issues (hallucinations, poor codebase navigation, file-deletion incidents) that temper an otherwise clear delivery of 'official CLI' status.
